entities.summary: Krystyna Czajkowska-Rawska is a former Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1955–1968, a bronze medalist of the Olympic Games, a bronze medalist of the World Championship 1962 and medalist of the European Championship, eight-time Polish Champion, head coach.
